text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: To my beloved Mom and Dad, I decided to start this letter off more seriously. And that's because…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Today was the first race of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I did an interview before the race and they asked a bunch of bonkers questions. My answers weren't that good, so my heart was pounding like nobody's business!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: By the way, the racer being interviewed after me, Harp Alpha, dazzled just like a star. She wasn't fazed by anything they asked her. She was so cool… Anyway!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: What I'm trying to say is that the Tiara racers looked like they meant business! But that didn't stop me! I went into today's race heart ablaze!
